## Changes

- Rework network switch integrations for Cisco and Juniper devices with various improvements and bug fixes
- Improve Bitwarden password query performance for multiple requests
- Improve Bitwarden login dialog to be more clear
- Add password manager setting to switch between names and IDs when selecting entries from the list dialog
- Improve role login on newly cloned team vault to auto-detect available roles

## Fixes

- Fix mstsc credentials not being cleared properly during the session
- Fix mstsc docked window freezing when minimized
- Fix git force push sometimes getting a permission denied error
- Fix newly cloned git vault setting all entries to expanded
- Fix file browser uploads failing for files on Windows network paths (Thanks to @mk868 for the PR)
- Fix category indentation not properly updating in all cases when moving them
- Fix a few errors with generic S3 buckets
- Fix SFTP session freezing on some Windows systems on initial connect
- Fix SSH open in Antigravity workspace action not working for Antigravity IDE
- Fix cloned connections not copying tags
- Fix various rare concurrency issues
